title: The Whispering Rift
author: Example Pack

hook.text: A violet RIFT shimmers low among the wheat, leading DOWN.

intro: You slide down through the rift and land in a cave of singing crystal.

cave.name: Crystal Cave
cave.desc: Violet crystals jut from every wall, humming softly. A tunnel leads FORWARD. The rift glimmers UP above you.
cave.hint: Go FORWARD to explore. Go UP to leave.

chamber.name: Echo Chamber

desc.text: The great crystal lies shattered. The echoes have fallen silent. The cave is BACK.
A vast round chamber. In the middle stands one enormous CRYSTAL, faintly glowing. Every footstep echoes a hundred times. The cave is BACK.

chamber.listen: Your breathing echoes back at you... louder... LOUDER.

hint.text: Take the gem and head home.
This place loves echoes. Make some noise! SHOUT.

desc.text: A towering violet crystal. It thrums when you speak near it.

gem.name: star gem
gem.desc: A tiny gem with a star trapped inside it. Worth a fortune somewhere.

do.say: You bellow at the top of your lungs. The echoes build and build... the crystal shrieks... and SHATTERS! Something sparkles among the shards.
It hums angrily but doesn't budge. Maybe try your voice instead.
You climb up through the rift.
